title: Save eight coefficient ADDs in the actual Gaussian reader (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

An explicit rational centre-basis shear reduces the actual rank-30 Gaussian reader's four-shear coefficient tariff by eight ADDs:

```diff
- 2 * (208 source + 9968 reader coefficients) = 20352
+ 2 * (208 source + 9964 reader coefficients) = 20344
```

After Ali Romman's #5646 basis, use `D5 += (3/40) D4` and `J4 -= (3/40) J5`. The source/reader product is unchanged, every arbitrary dirty centre is restored, and the word still uses four shears and thirty borrowed fields. This is a finite explicit rational-kernel construction with a scoped algebraic proof. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

The common denominator changes from 960 to 1200, adding a second factor of five. The maximum coefficient remains one, and the maximum absolute row sums remain 9/4 and 1036/15. This improves the declared coefficient-support tariff; physical rational arithmetic may have a different price.

Only `research/rational-reader-basis` is added. The first strict improvement ends the search; no optimality is claimed. The result was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ali Romman #5646 for the actual factors, published basis and open question, David Ganz / Dugongue #5634 for the reader identity, #5640 for the grouped tariff, and the retained centre-code-services lineage and source notices.

## Evidence

- Before: reader row five has 892 coefficients; the complete bill is 20,352.
- After: it has 888 coefficients; the complete bill is 20,344.
- The new replay compares all 11,208 nonzero coefficients of the affected two-term kernel product, reverses the exact basis and checks all untouched factors.
- A literal 512-address execution counts every instruction in both words, compares every data output and restores all thirty arbitrary dirty fields. Five controls detect losing coefficients, an omitted inverse source update and a corrupted reader coefficient. The written algebra covers arbitrary payloads; the one finite payload is an instruction-order control.
- Local CPython 3.12.15 warning-strict normal and optimized checks pass, each taking about 1.84 seconds. These times establish timeout margin, not a speedup claim.
- Registered metadata and both replay commands pass. Exact committed bytes/modes and full source history pass at `dfba21817680dbbd1ca0455cae5e5e93c97710fb`. Official export/input coverage, a read-only Git-free optimized replay and source-corruption rejection pass.

From the repository root:

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/rational-reader-basis/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/rational-reader-basis/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rational-reader-basis
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rational-reader-basis --check-source-history
```

Expected statuses are `PASS_RATIONAL_READER_BASIS`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The verifier emits a generated hash-bound JSON receipt. No predecessor verifier, rank/inverse audit, local-optimum replay or historical suite is run.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The supplied boundary `DJ=0` and factor construction are cited from the predecessors. The new proof establishes preservation and the new support count; it does not independently validate those predecessors. Rational arithmetic interiors, rounding, routing, tape/storage, a complete recursive invoice, native/outer admission and a full multiplication theorem remain open. No proof assistant or selected cold replay was run. All five framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Does the eight-instruction saving survive the extra factor of five in one concrete rational-arithmetic caller? Start by pricing these exact coefficients, rounding, routing and storage.
2. Can a broader basis reduce support and the complete physical bill further? Start from these explicit factors and a priced candidate; this contribution claims no optimum or follow-up reservation.

## Related open work

Refreshed this account's open PRs created after the [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19217759): #5920, #5921, #5922, #5923, #5924, #5925, #5926, #5927 and #5928. Their titles and result scopes were read; none studies the actual rank-30 Gaussian-reader coefficient bill. No additional computation was run to compare other contributions.

No open PR studying this same reader was found in the earlier live searches for `5634`, `5646` and `Gaussian reader`. Merged #5646, #5634 and #5640 are credited predecessors. The other rank-30 search reference concerns a historical moment profile, not this reader. These searches do not cover unpublished work.

## CI notes

At `dfba21817680dbbd1ca0455cae5e5e93c97710fb`, [run 40513266276](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40513266276) finished with **plan failed; replay skipped**. The only failed step is [Onboarding helper tests](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40513266276/job/122220255811). The unchanged `tests/test_research_current_assignment.py` ends with `FAILED (failures=8, errors=2, skipped=22)`. Its two errors are `KeyError: 'follow_up_steps'` and `KeyError: 'catalog_first_step'`; the eight failures concern current-assignment card/receipt and missing/sparse-reference expectations.

The same step, test file and failure summary were directly confirmed for PR #5918 at `d3d1e2155620e2a491523c759e1569587678b922` in [run 40506994991](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40506994991). This package adds only its seven scoped files and changes none of those shared tests or helpers. Maintainers own the shared failure; no repair or rerun was attempted here.

**Hosted replay has not certified this package. Only the local scientific and publication checks listed above have run.** CI did not execute the package replay.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package. Existing sources, shared tooling and the selected frontier are unchanged.
